connector.name: Acuris MCP
connector.registryDescription: Address validation & geocoding for AI agents: 240+ countries, UK PAF, free US/CA enrichment
connector.summary: Hosted at api.acuris-geo.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.acuris-geo, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Acuris API key> — get a free trial key via the request_trial_key tool or https://www.acuris-geo.com/acuris-pricing/
